name: Office Tycoon for Orca
description: Every agent on your Orca host as a little pixel worker in a tycoon-style office.

cover.alt: The hangout in the Loft: agents chatting at a round white table, one on the sofa on a pink rug, a coffee counter and foosball

screenshots.alt: The whole office in the Loft: five teams at islands of desks behind navy curtains under tall garden windows, and the hangout in the middle
A team at its island of six desks, nameplates on the monitors, and a speech bubble from an agent that just finished
Two small teams sharing a room: a red screen for blocked, specialists on stools beside their agent, a dimmed sleeping desk
